facts.fact: Nexus Core Systems president Christopher Yoshida announced on LinkedIn the start of construction of an AI computing platform at Nouaceur, built by FiveNines for Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, with 20 MW due in Q3 2027 and 180 MW by 2028.
